name: @coding-adventures/forme-aot-rss-discovery-link
description: Emit HTML <link rel="alternate" type="application/rss+xml"> tags for feed auto-discovery.  Pure transform: validates href URL (http(s):// OR root-relative), type allowlist (rss+xml | atom+xml | json), HTML-attribute-escapes title.  FM00 v0 emitter.
author: Adhithya Rajasekaran
